# Pokémon Sleep Web App (Desktop + Mobile H5)

> High-performance Vanilla JS Pokémon Sleep web application providing dual surfaces (Desktop SPA + Mobile H5), comprehensive Pokédex, recipe calculator, wiki database, box management with OCR recognition, and deep 6D appraisal lab.

## System Architecture
- Dual Surfaces:
  - Desktop SPA: `index.html` (multi-column responsive layout)
  - Mobile H5 App: `app/index.html` (safe area, 2-character bottom dock, bottom sheets)
- Shared Core Data: `data/data.json`, `data/recipes.json`, `data/news.json`, `data/special_icons.json`
- Module Layer:
  - `js/core/i18n.js`: Bilingual engine (zh-TW, en-US)
  - `js/core/cloudSync.js`: Supabase cloud sync & conflict resolution
  - `js/modules/app.js`: Pokédex core, search, filters, modal detail controller
  - `js/modules/appraisal.js`: 6D radar appraisal engine, scoring & intelligent summaries
  - `js/modules/box.js`: Pokémon box manager, OCR engine, Good-Night Ribbon PR calculations
  - `js/modules/wiki.js`: Game wiki, subskills, natures, ingredient ladder, sleep EXP
  - `js/modules/recipes.js`: Cooking recipes, pot capacity stepper, dish bonuses
  - `js/modules/news.js`: News events, touch Gantt chart, event banners
- Styles: `css/styles.css` (4 themes: Midnight, Onyx, Dawn, Emerald; strictly scoped `.mobile-h5-app`)

## Authoritative Documentation & Specifications
- `docs/SKILL_SPECIALISTS_AND_BFS_META_ANALYSIS.md`: Authoritative specification on Skill Specialists & Berry Finding S (BFS) synergy, Sneaky Snacking mechanics, Berry Burst, Charge Strength dual-track, and legendary beast mechanics.
- `docs/OPTIMAL_BUILDS_AND_META_LOGIC.md`: Pokémon God Presets, nature ladders, and appraisal algorithms.
- `docs/THEME_COLOR_SPEC.md`: 4-Theme contrast specifications and pre/post check protocols.
- `docs/SIDEBAR_HANDLE_RULE.md`: Sidebar bookmark handle visibility and collapsed/expanded rules.
- `docs/SPECIAL_ICONS_RULES.md`: Vector SVG icon rendering specifications.
- `docs/POKEMON_RECRUITMENT_PROBABILITY_ANALYSIS.md`: Math models for sleep style encounter rates and biscuit efficiency.
- `docs/walkthrough.md`: Historical progression and technical logs for Demands 1-44.

## Critical Engineering Constraints
- Zero Emoji Policy: Strict prohibition of emojis anywhere in UI text, code, logs, and markdown files.
- Single Frame Rule: No redundant nested outer borders around card grids, lists, or tables.
- Dropdown Arrow Rule: Select arrows must have right inset (`padding-right: 36px`, `background-position: right 18px center`).
- Shell Command Rule: Always prefix shell commands with `rtk`.
- Test Verification: `rtk node tests/run_tests.js` (171 tests, must always pass 100%).
- Agent Docs Protocol: Canonical path `~/.gemini/agent-docs/projects/pokemon-sleep-app/`.
